alley.line: I'm an innocent victim of a blinded alley
alley.linePrev: You'll go Waltzing Mathilda with me
alley.lineNext: And I'm tired of all these soldiers here

alley.line: Let me walk through the stinking alleys
stanza: Let me walk through the stinking alleys
To the music of drunken beatings
Past the Thames River glistening like gold
Hastily sold for nothing, nothing

alley.line: There's a ballet being fought out in the alley
stanza: Well, the midnight gangs assembled
And picked a rendezvous for the night
They'll meet 'neath that giant Exxon sign
That brings this fair city light
Man, there's an opera out on the turnpike
There's a ballet being fought out in the alley
Until the local cops' cherry top
Rips this holy night

valley.line: As I drove into the valley
stanza: And the lights of L.A. County
They looked like diamonds in the sky
As I drove into the valley
With my old friend at my side

valley.line: I saw the river playing in the valley
stanza: I saw the river playing in the valley
Rushing 'round a bend and skipping stones
I saw the meadow wobble in the moonlight
I've come to get my girl and take her home

valley.line: I come from down in the valley
stanza: I come from down in the valley
Where, mister, when you're young
They bring you up to do
Like your daddy done
Me and Mary, we met in high school
When she was just seventeen
We'd drive out of this valley
Down to where the fields were green

valley.line: In the form of shining valleys
stanza: I was dreaming in my dreaming
Of an aspect bright and fair
And my sleeping, it was broken
But my dream, it lingered near
In the form of shining valleys
Where the pure air recognized
And my senses newly opened
I awakened to the cry

valley.line: All the vampires walkin' through the valley
stanza: All the vampires walkin' through the valley
Move west down Ventura Boulevard
And all the bad boys are standing in the shadows
And the good girls are home with broken hearts
